name: organ-ai
description: ORGAN AI – The Ultimate AI Tools Universe

scripts.dev: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const MIME = { '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'application/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.png': 'image/png', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml' }; http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = path.join('.', req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.split('?')[0]); if (fs.existsSync(p) && fs.statSync(p).isFile()) { res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': MIME[path.extname(p)] || 'text/plain' }); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } }).listen(8181, () => console.log('Server running on http://localhost:8181'));"
